title: IT Transformation Strategy
lead: A service to define, validate or refresh the IT strategy as the foundation for a transformation engagement.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: The IT Transformation Strategy service establishes or refreshes the IT strategy as the starting point for a larger transformation programme. It combines stakeholder interviews, analysis of the current IT landscape, and benchmarking to produce a clear strategic direction, capability gaps and a transformation roadmap.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: IT Transformation Strategy is typically the first service delivered in an ITOM engagement. Without a clear IT strategy, operating model design risks producing a model that is technically sound but strategically misaligned. The output of this service directly feeds the ITOM design.

items.desc: Current state assessment of IT capabilities, landscape and performance.
Workshops to align leadership on IT direction and priorities.
IT vision, principles, strategic objectives and sourcing model.
Sequenced initiatives to close the gap between current and target state.
Investment justification for the transformation programme.
